name: Stop Thief
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Spot the escaping thief running away with the stolen item.
Grab a barrier, trip tool, or object nearby to block the path.
Place or throw the item directly in front of the thief’s route.
Catch the thief as they stumble or stop moving.
Secure the stolen item back to complete the stage.
